verdict.rationale: Anthropic's docs claim Skills can be loaded/invoked automatically 'when relevant' without explicit user action (docs-3, docs-25, docs-34), which is the closest analog to 'rules triggering actions on events' since Skills aren't built around discrete event/webhook triggers. However, multiple hands-on community reports directly contradict reliable automatic triggering — users report skills frequently fail to activate even when semantically relevant, requiring explicit invocation or duplicating instructions into AGENTS.md to get consistent behavior (comm-6, comm-7, comm-9, comm-10, comm-11, comm-12). Missing for 10: dedicated event/trigger-rule system (e.g., cron, webhooks, file-watchers) distinct from LLM relevance-based invocation, and independent benchmarking of auto-trigger reliability.
